## Operating systems and platforms

When does this operating system or platform version stop getting fixes?

| Resource | Run by | What it is and when to use it | Kind | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Microsoft Lifecycle: product and services search](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/lifecycle/products/) | Microsoft | Microsoft's lookup for the lifecycle of its commercial products and services: search a name to open that product's support dates; an export page is linked. | Reference | Free |
| [Exchange Server supportability matrix](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/exchange/plan-and-deploy/supportability-matrix) | Microsoft | Microsoft's tables of what each Exchange Server version supports, including builds, operating systems, Active Directory environments, browsers, email clients, and .NET Framework. | Reference | Free |
| [Red Hat Enterprise Linux Life Cycle](https://access.redhat.com/support/policy/updates/errata) | Red Hat | Red Hat's policy page for RHEL support, in sections including production phases, what maintenance each phase receives, extended support offerings, and life-cycle dates by version. | Reference | Free |
| [Ubuntu release cycle](https://ubuntu.com/about/release-cycle) | Canonical | Canonical's lifecycle page: a form that answers whether a product version is still covered, then sections including interim and LTS releases, Ubuntu Pro, and ESM. | Reference | Free |
| [Debian Releases](https://www.debian.org/releases/) | Debian | Debian's releases page, including what stable, testing, and unstable mean, the release life cycle, and an index linking current and historic releases. | Reference | Free |
| [SUSE Product Support Lifecycle](https://www.suse.com/lifecycle/) | SUSE | SUSE's table of lifecycle dates by product, with a product filter, a view of end-of-life products, and links to the support lifecycle policies. | Reference | Free |
| [AlmaLinux Release Notes](https://wiki.almalinux.org/release-notes/) | AlmaLinux OS Foundation | AlmaLinux tables of minor releases by major version, with columns including codename, release date, and kernel, and a line on when that version's support ends. | Reference | Free |
| [FreeBSD Security Information](https://www.freebsd.org/security/) | The FreeBSD Project | The FreeBSD Project's security page, including the table of supported releases with expected end-of-life dates, how to report an incident, and how to update. | Reference | Free |
| [The Linux Kernel Archives: Releases](https://www.kernel.org/category/releases.html) | The Linux Kernel Organization | kernel.org's explanation of kernel release categories, from prepatch and mainline to stable and longterm, with the longterm release table and a releases FAQ. | Reference | Free |
| [ChromeOS Auto Update policy](https://support.google.com/chrome/a/answer/6220366) | Google | Google's ChromeOS update policy, with tables by manufacturer listing approved device models and the month until which they get automatic updates; some need an opt-in. | Reference | Free |
| [Kubernetes Releases](https://kubernetes.io/releases/) | Kubernetes | Kubernetes release history: the minor versions now maintained, each with its patch releases and end-of-life date, the end-of-life releases, the upcoming release, and resource links. | Reference | Free |
| [Kubernetes version lifecycle on Amazon EKS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/kubernetes-versions.html) | Amazon Web Services | AWS user guide page on Kubernetes versions in EKS, including versions on standard and extended support, a release calendar, and FAQs. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Supported Kubernetes versions in AKS](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/aks/supported-kubernetes-versions) | Microsoft | Microsoft's page on Kubernetes version support in AKS, including the support policy, a release calendar with upcoming versions, LTS versions, and breaking changes by version. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [GKE release schedule](https://docs.cloud.google.com/kubernetes-engine/docs/release-schedule) | Google Cloud | Google Cloud's table of estimated dates when GKE minor versions become available and auto-upgrade in Rapid, Regular, Stable, and Extended channels, and when support ends. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Amazon Linux 2023 release cadence](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/linux/al2023/ug/release-cadence.html) | Amazon Web Services | AWS user guide page on Amazon Linux 2023's support timeline: standard support with quarterly minor updates until June 2027, then maintenance until June 2029. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Windows 11 release information](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/release-health/windows11-release-information) | Microsoft | Release information for each Windows 11 version. | Reference | Free |
| [Windows Server release information](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/release-health/windows-server-release-info) | Microsoft | Release information for Windows Server versions. | Reference | Free |
| [Update history for Microsoft 365 Apps (listed by date)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/officeupdates/update-history-microsoft365-apps-by-date) | Microsoft | Table of every Microsoft 365 Apps build by release date and update channel, each linked to its release notes. | Reference | Free |
| [endoflife.date](https://endoflife.date/) | endoflife.date project | End-of-life dates and support schedules for hundreds of products, with an API and iCalendar support. | Reference | Free |
| [Microsoft Lifecycle Policy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/lifecycle/) | Microsoft | Microsoft's lifecycle policy pages: search a product to find its end-of-support dates under the Modern or Fixed policy. | Vendor documentation | Free |
